scope: Predeclared assessment method review, not an independent review of the author's projection implementation and not a candidate/runtime verdict. No full-asset analysis or simplifier/render process was launched.

four_views.contract: Use each authentic view camera location/right/up/outward direction and stored ortho_scale without reframing. Pinned original render_views.py establishes ORTHO and original clip policy. Top-level preassignment shared_ortho_scale is not substituted for per-view stored scale.

silhouette_and_foliage.sampling: Opaque, two-sided orthographic pixel centres at column+.5,row+.5; top-left image origin. No antialiasing, shaded-image or continuous silhouette claim.
silhouette_and_foliage.foreground: Closest positive in-clip triangle depth; exact depth ties choose lowest original face-row index.
silhouette_and_foliage.visible_foliage: Only pixels whose closest original face belongs to the authentic4531-face ROI are required. Hidden original foliage does not become a visible-retention claim.
silhouette_and_foliage.candidate_depth_requirement: Candidate must cover the same original visible-foliage pixel centre and its closest depth must differ by <=0.005*D. A farther brick surface cannot substitute for the removed leaf.
silhouette_and_foliage.empty_foliage_view: Explicitly uninformative, never reported as100%retention; aggregate must have at least one informative foliage view.
silhouette_and_foliage.empty_full_source_view: Reject; it cannot establish a required silhouette.
silhouette_and_foliage.D_policy: Use one frozen original AABB diagonal for both geometry and foliage depth gates; never derive or resize D from the candidate.

bounded_raster_work.method: Project vertices once; pre-count clipped pixel-centre bounding-box events per triangle; expand only those events, compute vectorized barycentrics/depth and scatter closest depth. Never form all-triangles by all-pixels arrays or millions of Python triangle objects.
bounded_raster_work.rejects: Nonfinite coordinates/projection/depth, invalid indices/dimensions/basis, clipping, world-space zero-area triangles or work-budget excess reject the whole measurement. Valid world triangles with exactly zero projected area are explicitly counted as edge-on.
bounded_raster_work.private_outputs: Caller saves full Boolean mask, finite zero-background depth and front-face/visible-foliage arrays under owned private paths; public results contain scalar counts and errors.
bounded_raster_work.memory_projection: For original4173584faces, I32 lower/upper boxes plus I64 counts/cumulative arrays total133554688bytes. Original1957891vertex projection is46989384bytes. Bounded event scratch is approximately100MB; extra local-ID scratch may add approximately100MB for long zero-event gaps. These are projections excluding source arrays/allocator overhead, not measured process bounds.

nearest_referenced_vertex_upper_bound.definition: For sample p and target surface S made from retained triangles, its referenced vertices V are a subset of S. Therefore dist(p,S)<=min(v in V)||p-v||. Pointwise upper bounds also upper-bound the sampled RMS, linear95th percentile and maximum.
nearest_referenced_vertex_upper_bound.valid_admission: Passing the nearest-referenced-vertex bounds implies the corresponding true sample-to-surface distances satisfy the same limits. It is conservative and can produce a false NO-GO; it cannot establish a continuous Hausdorff bound.
nearest_referenced_vertex_upper_bound.tree_inputs: Only vertex IDs actually referenced by the target faces; original but unreferenced rows must be excluded. Coordinates remain the exact original F32 values promoted to F64 for CPU cKDTree.
nearest_referenced_vertex_upper_bound.query_policy: Exact k=1 query with eps=0; no approximate nearest-neighbour allowance, no silent missing/infinite query, bounded thread count.
forward_samples: One deterministic representative face centroid for each207original face-bearing components
nearest_referenced_vertex_upper_bound.reverse_samples: 2048fixed area-stratified candidate face-interior positions to original referenced vertices. Freeze representative/strata rules and tie breaks before candidate results.
nearest_referenced_vertex_upper_bound.memory_projection: Original referenced F64XYZ about47MB plus intp tree indices about16MB and native nodes; two source/target trees are projected around0.3GB, not a measured bound.

component_certificate.rule: Candidate indices retain original vertex IDs. Every candidate triangle must have three equal original component labels and the complete candidate face-bearing label set must equal the207original labels. No missing component or cross-component bridge is rescued by pooled geometry/silhouette statistics. Unused original vertex components do not count as surface components.

source_faithful_colour_validation.representation: Index-only simplification preserves exact original vertex coordinates/IDs and original native colour bytes; it performs no attribute optimization, interpolation fit, welding or output-driven adjustment. All retained corner RGBA bytes must equal the authenticated original oracle indexed by retained original vertex IDs.
source_faithful_colour_validation.bounded_field_check: For each16original frozen region vertex pools, eligible candidate faces contain at least one original vertex from that pool. Freeze128candidate interior query positions per region with seed20261021+i and original region order; no candidate-colour-driven choice.
source_faithful_colour_validation.authentic_target: Sample original sparse six-channel material field at those actual candidate world positions using the pinned CPU SparseSampler; positive support is required at every query. Compare actual candidate linear-colour barycentric interpolation after IEC encoding against clipped original sampled RGB, and unchanged actualM/R/OPAQUEalpha against sampled scalar channels.
source_faithful_colour_validation.limitations: This is a predeclared bounded field/interpolation check, not an all-surface or all56910historical-query claim. Original byte identity alone cannot certify interpolated face-interior material quality. No new neural/native model kernel is needed.

cheapest_reusable_sources.docs/compatibility/amd-brick-defect-diag: Existing authenticated ORTHO basis/PNG-centre convention; its per-ray full-face scans are for a few rays, not a640square mask.
Exact NumPy edge/component semantics and previously persisted source component cache; reuse authenticated original labels rather than rebuilding source graph in the candidate process.
cheapest_reusable_sources.docs/compatibility/amd-brick-uv-bake-evi: Genuine sparse CPU trilinear sample_world; <=65536queries/batch, F32 arithmetic, native world+0.5 then*512 mapping, explicit support diagnostics.
cheapest_reusable_sources.docs/compatibility/amd-brick-full-colour: Unchanged per-region RGB/scalar gates without factor or colour fitting.
cheapest_reusable_sources.docs/compatibility/amd-turret-face-fan-e: Useful semantics only; explicit6000-face cap, Python lists/BVH and per-face raster prevent direct full-asset reuse.

resource_admission: Each future owned stage retains <=6GiB process AND Job memory,180seconds,12GiB available RAM and2GiB free disk floors, attached-before-exact-GO and natural owned-tree exit. Abort rather than relax work/resource limits or retry another candidate.
